armorer.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Welcome. As an adventurer, you should know how crucial it is that you stay protected. So, if you find yourself in need of new armor, you know where to look!
armorer.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Ah, a traveler? Have you been looking for quality armor that could withstand blows from the mightiest of monsters?! Well, look no more!
armorer.dialogue.human_first.generic/3: Hello, and welcome to our village! It's been a while since last we saw an adventurer. Me? I'm a local armorer! I bet someone like you needs good armor on their journeys!
butcher.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Ahoy, traveler! If you need fill for a hungry stomach, you've found the right place!
butcher.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Ah, you must be this traveler everyone is talking about! A simple butcher I might be, but even I know such journeys can be tiresome, even to an adventurer such as yourself! Why don't you stop by for a bite or two?
butcher.dialogue.human_first.generic/3: Welcome! The best meat in town, perfect for any ravenous adventurer! Come now, before I get sold out!
fisherman.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Oh, you're a traveler? Welcome, I am this fine village's fisherman. If you feel hungry for some quality fresh fish, you know where to find me!
fisherman.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Ah, an adventurer! Someone like you surely must know the value of hard work! In such a case, why don't you take a peek at my catches?
fisherman.dialogue.human_first.generic/3: Welcome to our village! I'm this village's fisherman, as you can see. I'm sure someone who travels the world far and wide such as yourself must know a thing or two, as well! If you need any help with fishing, I'd be more than happy to help. For a price, of course!
farmer.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Hello, traveler. As you can see, It's hard work to keep everyone fed in this village, so I will pay handsomely if you could help me catch a break in the fields.
farmer.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Welcome to our village, adventurer. Farming is hard work, but I'm still proud of it. Be sure to swing by, I'll always have food in stock.
farmer.dialogue.human_first.generic/3: Oh! An adventurer! Why, hello there! I'm a proud village farmer. If you need any help, feel free to just ask.
cleric.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Hello, adventurer. Welcome to our small village. As you might have guessed, I'm a cleric. If you find yourself in need of various potions, I would be more than happy to help.
cleric.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Welcome, adventurer. Please feel at home in our village, and may the god's light be with you. Do not hesitate to ask for help if you find yourself in need.
cleric.dialogue.human_first.generic/3: I'm this village's cleric. I am responsible for healing those of us unfortunate enough to fall to the plague. If you ever happen to come across rotten flesh, hesitate not, and bring them to me.
librarian.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Oh, so you must be the traveler I keep hearing about. Well, welcome to this humble village of ours, I'm the local librarian. You're always welcome to look around my library; just be sure to be silent as you peruse the books.
librarian.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Welcome, traveler. I am this town's librarian. Behave well, and you'll always be welcome in the library. I also try my hand at enchanting. Perhaps some of my enchanted books might pique your curiosity?
librarian.dialogue.human_first.generic/3: Hello, good traveler. It is always a pleasure to meet someone new, there's no better way to broaden one's horizons such as stories from afar. Your kind may find my stories 'enchanting' as well.
cartographer.dialogue.human_first.generi: Welcome, explorer. I'm this village's cartographer. It's my job to map the secrets of this world and I would be willing to share the fruits of my labor with you… for a price, of course.

Ah! An adventurer! Someone like you surely has to recognize the value of my work. I am a cartographer, and am more than happy to sell you my maps, as well as buy the resources. I could always use some spare paper!
Oh, I've been waiting for you to show up, explorer! If you ever happen to find yourself in need of help with finding treasures of old, I will be more than happy to assist you with my knowledge.
mason.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Welcome, traveler. I'm this town's mason. If you ever need help with stone materials and the money to back it up, I'd be more than happy to help!
mason.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Hello, adventurer! For my line of work, I need materials, lots of materials. I'd be willing to buy off any spare clay on you!
fletcher.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Welcome, brave adventurer!. I'm this village's fletcher. A bow is an adventurer's best friend, especially if you hope to best a creeper. Why don't you look at my wares sometime?
fletcher.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Welcome! I am certain someone like you has to appreciate what advantages bows offer! You've got to be low on arrows, being on the road so much!
leatherworker.dialogue.human_first.gener: Welcome, traveler. I am this village's leatherworker. As you probably know, it's my job to make sure everyone has fine clothes to wear. I would be most obliged if you ever checked my stock.
Welcome to this village. I am sure someone like you often happens to collect leathers from all kinds of animals, and I would be happy to buy them off you.
shepherd.dialogue.human_first.generic/1: Welcome, adventurer. I'm this village's shepherd, as you can probably tell. My wares probably don't amount to that much, but please still feel welcome to look at my wares.
shepherd.dialogue.human_first.generic/2: Hello, adventurer. I am this village's shepherd. If you ever happen to have spare amounts of wool, please let me have a look. I just might buy them off you.

dialogue.human_first.question/2: Finally a new face! What adventures brought you here?

dialogue.human_main.morning/9: What a beautiful morning! I think it's going to be a productive day today!
dialogue.human_main.morning/10: I think I might take it slow today, I'm not feeling too well.
dialogue.human_main.morning/11: I have a very packed schedule today, just thinking about it makes me tired.
dialogue.human_main.morning/12: I actually got a decent night's sleep, I might do something a bit heavier today, who knows?
child.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: I might go flower picking today, wanna come?
child.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: I'm going to see my friends! Are you going to see yours too?
child.dialogue.human_main.morning/4: I want to go exploring, but I have to finish my reading today. Why can't everyday be a play day?
child.dialogue.human_main.morning/5: I'm not allowed to do anything fun today. It's not fair.
child.dialogue.human_main.morning/6: Everyone is tired today! I can't find anyone to play with me.
child.dialogue.human_main.morning/7: Can you take me somewhere today? I'm bored.
teen.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: I wouldn't be up this early if I had a choice.
teen.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: I was dragged out of bed, can you tell?
teen.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: This is an unholy hour of the morning. Why are you so chipper?
teen.dialogue.human_main.morning/4: Time to get moving, I guess.
teen.dialogue.human_main.morning/5: What I wouldn't give to be back in bed.
teen.dialogue.human_main.morning/6: Do you have any food on you? I forgot to eat breakfast.
dialogue.human_main.evening/2: It got late pretty fast, how was your day?
dialogue.human_main.evening/3: Another hard day of work, am I right?
dialogue.human_main.evening/4: The day flew by, didn't it? Too much to do, too little time.
dialogue.human_main.evening/5: I think I might head home soon, I need to get started on dinner.
dialogue.human_main.evening/6: I wasted too much time today, I didn't really do much.
dialogue.human_main.evening/7: I think I might go for a nap soon, I had a rough morning.
dialogue.human_main.evening/8: I might go inside, last month I saw a creeper, I don't walk around at night anymore.
dialogue.human_main.evening/9: Oh hey! I was buying stuff for dinner at the butcher, talk to you later!
child.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: I have to be home soon, or my family might get worried.
child.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: It's getting really dark, really quickly! Why are days so short?
child.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: I'm a little bit tired, but I can go a long time without a nap now!
child.dialogue.human_main.evening/4: I want to go around my friend's house, but I'm in trouble. Should I go anyways?
child.dialogue.human_main.evening/5: I can go around the village all by myself now, even when it gets darker! But I wouldn't mind if you came with me.
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: I'm going to go into the woods later, don't rat me out to the guards, kay?
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: I have so much work to finish, but I really don't want to do it. Need help with anything?
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: There's not much to do around here, especially when all the stores close.
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/4: The guards don't let us stay out too late because of the monsters. It's really annoying. You don't think you could sneak me out, could you?
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/5: I wanted to hang out with the others today, but I didn't get the chance to. Are you free?
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/7: I know it's dangerous at night, but at least it's quiet. It makes it easier to think about stuff, you know?
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/8: ... maybe I should fix my sleeping schedule. It's so late but I don't feel tired at all
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/9: The sunset sure looks cool, don't you think? Like the sky was on fire… or something like that.
teen.dialogue.human_main.evening/10: Well, it's not too late for another stroll. There's not much else to do in a village, you know. Well, it probably beats sleeping next to creepers for all I know.
dialogue.human_main.night/2: A bit of a night owl, aren't you?
dialogue.human_main.night/4: Don't stray too far from the village. Wouldn't want you to get stuck out there with the monsters, would we?
dialogue.human_main.night/5: The guards always make the village feel safer, but it is still awfully eerie at night, isn't it?
dialogue.human_main.night/6: The darkness always makes me feel peaceful, it's a nice time to relax when the world is quiet.
dialogue.human_main.night/7: It's always so busy in the day time, so it is nice to go for a stroll when the stars are out.
dialogue.human_main.night/8: I'm getting really tired. I suppose it's been a long day, I might need to take it easier tomorrow.
dialogue.human_main.night/9: I can't wait to burrow underneath the covers.
dialogue.human_main.night/10: You should really go to sleep. I hear you have a lot to do tomorrow.
child.dialogue.human_main.night/1: *yawn* Why are you up so late? It's so dark already.
child.dialogue.human_main.night/2: *yawn* Can't we talk some other time? I'm really, really, really sleepy.
child.dialogue.human_main.night/3: *just yawns and doesn't seem to quite notice you're there*
child.dialogue.human_main.night/4: I'm going to play the whoooole day when I wake up…
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/1: Don't you see I'm trying to sleep?
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/2: Go hunt those zombies outside or whatever you adventurers do. I'm trying to sleep.
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/3: Why are you in my house at this hour?
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/4: Talk to me one more time, and I'm calling the guards. Git.
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/5: Look, I appreciate it and all, but some people are trying to sleep at this hour.
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/6: I don't mean to be mean or anything, but you should probably sleep too.
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/7: Shouldn't you be at your own place at this hour or something?.
teen.dialogue.human_main.night/10: *Clearly isn't asleep, but won't talk to you all the same.*
cultist.dialogue.human_main/1: There’s a lot you still have to learn.
cultist.dialogue.human_main/2: If you wonder how I have all these Sirben children then it’s a secret.
cultist.dialogue.human_main/3: Would you like to become one with the Sirbens..?
guard.dialogue.human_main/2: I’m a little busy, please go bother someone else.
guard.dialogue.human_main/4: I don’t like how quiet it is...
guard.dialogue.human_main/5: It’s a peaceful day, I hope it stays this peaceful.
guard.dialogue.human_main/6: You know, I once thought someone was attacking me, when I realise I'd hit an armour stand. Didn't make that mistake twice.
guard.dialogue.human_main/7: I don't know who you are, don't make me have to find out.
guard.dialogue.human_main/9: I've always wondered how strong a rose gold sword would be.
guard.dialogue.human_main/10: Did you hear that? I'm sure there's something out there...
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: Good morning, %1$s. Whatever you do today, please stay safe.
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: If there's one perk about being a guard, it's that you can rest when the sun is up. Unfortunately, it's not just monsters we have to worry about…
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: You're not causing any trouble around here, are you?
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/4: *Is clearly too focused on the patrol to notice you*
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/5: Yes, I know there never are any monsters in the daytime… but I always can't help but see illagers in any bush I turn my head to. Maybe I really need a nap, after all…*
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/6: Good morning, %1$s. Remember to make a report if you see anything suspicious, alright?
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/7: When the last raid happened, it was because we didn't notice illager scouts. It won't ever happen again.
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/8: Oh, welcome, %1$s. Do you want to keep me company on my watch?.
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/9: Hello. You can feel safe now. There are no monsters during the day. Well, most of the time.
guard.dialogue.human_main.morning/10: You aren't doing anything suspicious, are you…? Oh, no, I'm only asking… just asking… hehehe….
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: It's going to be nighttime soon. You should probably head indoors.
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: The setting sun sure looks beautiful… I just wish it didn't mean more monsters to deal with. Eh.
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: Just between you and me, I really wish I could just head home for the day and not worry about any zombies or skeletons.
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/4: It's evening already. I'm not sure if we should be talking right now...
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/5: Guard duty isn't as depressing as some say. It's great if you need lots of time to think… not that I slack off at my post, gods forbid!
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/6: I used to dream about being a guard when I was just a child, but a life of a guard isn't as grand as I thought. Then again, the more boring your job as a guard is, the better.
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/7: I used to go into the caves just like you, back when I was training to become a guard.
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/8: The monsters will come out any minute now. Head indoors if you don't want to have to fight them.
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/9: If you ever find yourself in trouble, just find me. I will do everything I can to help.
guard.dialogue.human_main.evening/10: Don't stray too far from the village if you're not well prepared, %1$s.
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/1: I just hate those zombies, and there's never an end to them!
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/2: If you want to be helpful, you can watch here for the monsters with me.
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/3: ... should I make another round, already?
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/4: Make sure to watch out for these cursed creepers, %1$s.
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/5: I'm sometimes not sure what I hate more. Creepers, or skeletons?
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/6: A few days ago, I had to put down a zombie that clearly wasn't gone far enough to be cured… moments like these haunt me when I try to sleep.
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/7: Make sure not to run in a straight line when you're facing a skeleton. Their arrows can be deadly.
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/8: ... I hope there won't be a zombie siege tonight.
guard.dialogue.human_main.night/9: I just want for this night to be finally over.
guard.dialogue.human_main.night10: Yes, we get scared too sometimes, but bravery isn't the lack of fear, it's the ability to control it for the greater cause. Now that I'm afraid. What?
farmer.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: Another morning, another day spent in the fields.
farmer.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: It's hard work to be a farmer, but it really pays off.
farmer.dialogue.human_main.morning3: One perk of being a farmer: it's up to you what food you get to eat later!
farmer.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: It was yet another productive day in the fields. I think I deserve some rest, now.
farmer.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: I love being a farmer, but it's hard on you. I'm really glad whenever the day's over and I can just relax.
farmer.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: I hope nothing is trampling my fields right now…
farmer.dialogue.human_main.night/1: *Yawns* Tomorrow will be another day of hard work in the fields. I need all the rest I can get..
farmer.dialogue.human_main.night/2: My body feels so sore after today… I feel like I can sleep like a log…
farmer.dialogue.human_main.night/3: You should probably sleep, too. And since it's my job to feed everyone in the village, I don't think I should be talking to you this late, either.
butcher.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: I'm sure the smell of fresh meat will lighten up the day for everyone.
butcher.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: There's more to my work than just killing pigs, you know. I'm working just as hard as anyone in the village.
butcher.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: Mmm. This meat looks so good I'd like to have some myself.
butcher.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: Well, that was a productive day. I've sure fed lots of people in the village.
butcher.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: I'm not really at work right now, but if you've got the money and want some quality, fresh meat, I'm still up for some trading.
butcher.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: I should probably make sure the animals breed tomorrow, I've been starting to run low… huh? Were you saying something?
butcher.dialogue.human_main.night/1: I should probably be in bed. People will want to buy some quality meat early tomorrow, and so I can't act be acting like a night owl.
butcher.dialogue.human_main.night/2: Huh? What? Do you want to buy some pork at this hour? Are you really serious?
butcher.dialogue.human_main.night/3: The butcher's work might not look tough, but darn, my body really is sore all over. I really need to go to sleep.
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: Ugh, I'm so tired. Then again, I can't just sleep in, or my animals will go hungry..
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: Huh? Can't wait it a little? I'm… *yawn* still so sleepy. My sheep kept me up at night far too long…
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: Work with wool can be a bit tiring sometimes, but it sure is rewarding. I'm speaking from experience!.
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: What? Time off? Well, I still need to feed the sheep before I go to bed, but I guess I'm kind of free, now.
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: If you want to trade some wool, now it would be good time to do it. I finally have some more time on my hands.
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: Don't tell anyone… but I really like mutton. Roast mutton, minced mutton, muttons steak… just don't mention it near the sheep!
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.night/1: I really hope my sheep are quiet today. Maybe I'll catch some good sleep..
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.night/2: I should call it a night. I need to get up early to feed my animals.
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.night/3: Isn't there some better time for us to trade? I'm sure you can find some better time to sell me wool. *Yawn.*.
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.night/4: Having trouble falling asleep? Try counting sheep.
shepherd.dialogue.human_main.night/5: Finally I've caught that runaway sheep!
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: When fishing, it's always best to start early in the day. That's how you get the most out of the day!
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: Do you have some materials to spare? Believe it or not,  but fishing rods don't last that long…
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: I sometimes feel sorry for these poor fish, but it's up to all of us to feed the village. It's in the cycle of nature.
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: It was a day well spent! Would you believe how many catches I've got?!.
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: I'm not really on the clock right now, but if you have some quality fish to sell, then hit me with it. I'm always open to a good trade!
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: No, I didn't become a fisherman because I liked fish. … I do like fish, though. Who doesn't? It's definitely not as heavy on stomach as pork or beef.
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.night/1: Hum? How can I help you? Sorry, but I really need to get to bed, or I will have a bad day fishing tomorrow…
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.night/2: What…? Don't tell me you've hit me up at this hour just to sell fish…?
fisherman.dialogue.human_main.night/3: I know fishing might not look too hard, but I'm really tired after fishing up till the afternoon. Can't we talk tomorrow?
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: Good morning, %1$s! Do you happen to be in need of some new, quality tools?!
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: It's sometimes hard to get myself to be fully awake, but then I always remind myself that the village relies on the tools I make. So, I can't allow myself to be lazy.
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: Do you happen to have some quality materials on hand? I could really use some.
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: Phew, that was a full day of work. It always makes me proud to see people use my tools, though
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: Yes, I'm technically off the clock now, but if you want to trade for a bit, I'm still open. I didn't get entirely sold out.
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: I love to make tools, but what I love even more is to get to just relax after a full day of work!
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.night/1: I should be in bed already. Tools take time to make, so I unfortunately can't afford sleep in too much.
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.night/2: Huh? Why are you here at this hour? Don't tell me you want to buy tools so late!
toolsmith.dialogue.human_main.night/3: Can't we talk later? It might not look hard, but I'm actually tired after today's toolsmithing work…
armorer.dialogue.human_main.morning/1: I'm proud of my work, but gods, isn't it tough to work all day by this damned blast furnace…
armorer.dialogue.human_main.morning/2: If you happen to have some resources you'd be willing to sell, I would be really grateful. It can be difficult to get my own sometimes.
armorer.dialogue.human_main.morning/3: It's so hot in here. I really wish I could just go outside today.
armorer.dialogue.human_main.evening/1: I take a lot of pride in being an armorer. It takes a lot of skill to create quality armor.
armorer.dialogue.human_main.evening/2: I'm technically not on the job right now, but yes, I have some pieces of armor if you want to buy any. I never get fully sold out..
armorer.dialogue.human_main.evening/3: I take pride in my job, but I'm glad to be away from that scorching hot blast furnace. It almost makes me want to jump into powder snow. Almost.
armorer.dialogue.human_main.night/1: Can't we talk anytime later? I need to sleep. A tired blacksmith is a bad blacksmith..
armorer.dialogue.human_main.night/2: ... please don't tell me you got me out of bed just to buy armor?
armorer.dialogue.human_main.night/3: Making armor is very tiring, especially when you have to work next to a smoking hot furnace. I can't wait to get into bed already.
weaponsmith.dialogue.human_main.morning/: Why, hello. Do you perhaps need a new sword? Or an axe? Or a bell?! Just kidding… unless?
Hello. If you happen to find yourself with some spare resources, I'll happily buy them off you. Weaponsmithing takes up a lot of them, you know.
Smithing quality weapons takes time. I would know.
weaponsmith.dialogue.human_main.evening/: If you need a new weapon, don't hesitate to ask. I barely ever get fully sold out.
I suppose it's nice to just sit down and rest after a whole day of working on weapons.
I know an adventurer likes you must appreciate well-made weapons. Huh? No, no, just saying… really. Why are you looking at me that way?
weaponsmith.dialogue.human_main.night/1: ... haven't you had the whole day to go shopping for weapons?
weaponsmith.dialogue.human_main.night/2: I'm soooo tired. And if I don't get my sleep I won't be able to smith a hoe, much less a functional sword!
weaponsmith.dialogue.human_main.night/3: I know you must be passionate about swords, but can't we talk about them later? It's too late for that now.
dialogue.busy/1: We already talked a lot today, I need to go back to work.
dialogue.busy/2: Look, I'm flattered, but I really need to get this work done by this evening.
dialogue.busy/3: I'm a little busy right now, mind if we chat later?
dialogue.busy/4: Sorry, but I need to work, I'll talk to you later.
dialogue.busy/5: I forgot my furnace lit, talk to you later!
dialogue.goaway/2: Don't you have anything better to do?
dialogue.human_greet/1: Hey! How are you doing today?
dialogue.human_greet/3: Oh, hello. Did you need something?
dialogue.human_greet/4: You look ready to take on the day! How's it going?
dialogue.human_greet/5: Hello %1$s! It's good to see you!
dialogue.human_greet/8: Hello! It's lovely to see you. How are you today?
male.childp.dialogue.human_greet/1: Hey dad! What are you up to?
male.childp.dialogue.human_greet/2: Hi dad, how are you doing?
male.childp.dialogue.human_greet/3: Hey dad! Missed you, what are you doing right now?
male.childp.dialogue.human_greet/4: Hey dad? Where are you going?
male.childp.dialogue.human_greet/6: Hi dad, are there chores you want me to do right now?
female.childp.dialogue.human_greet/1: Hey mom, what are you up to?
female.childp.dialogue.human_greet/3: Mom! I missed you, what are you doing right now?
female.childp.dialogue.human_greet/6: Hey mom, are there any chores I can help with around the house?
male.teenp.dialogue.human_greet/3: Hey dad! *hugs you* What are you up to?
male.teenp.dialogue.human_greet/5: Hey dad! Is there anything you need help with?
female.teenp.dialogue.human_greet/3: Hey ma! *hugs you* What are you up to?
female.teenp.dialogue.human_greet/5: Hey ma! Do you need help around the house?
male.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/1: Hey pops! What are you up to?
male.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/2: Hey old man, how things with you and mom?
male.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/3: Hey dad! Missed you, what are you doing right now?
male.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/4: *hugs* Hey dad! It's been a bit, what are you up to nowadays?
male.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/6: What's up dad? You doing alright?
female.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/1: Hey mom! What are you up to?
female.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/2: Hey old lady! *laughs* how things with you and dad?
female.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/3: *hugs tightly* Hey ma! Missed you, what are you doing right now?
female.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/4: Hey mom! It's been a bit, what are you up to nowadays?
female.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/6: What's up mom? You doing alright?
female.adultp.dialogue.human_greet/7: *hugs* Mama! How are you? Do you need a hand?
dialogue.human_greet.negative/1: Ew, go away, you're the LAST person I wanted to see!
dialogue.human_greet.negative/4: Oh. It's just you. I was expecting someone else.
male.toddlerp.dialogue.human_greet.negat: I don't like you right now dad!
female.toddlerp.dialogue.human_greet.neg: I don't like you right now mama!
male.childp.dialogue.human_greet.negativ: I don't want to talk right now dad!
I want to be alone right now dad.
female.childp.dialogue.human_greet.negat: I don't want to talk to you right now mom!
I want to be alone right now mom.
male.teenp.dialogue.human_greet.negative: *rolls eyes* What is it old man?
Dad, I've more important things right now, go away!
female.teenp.dialogue.human_greet.negati: Ugh! What do you want mom?
Mom, I'm not in the mood right now!
*rolls eyes* What is it old lady?
Mom, I've more important things right now, go away!
male.adultp.dialogue.human_greet.negativ: Pops! I don't care right now! Go away!
I don't want to talk to you for a while dad.
Dad, I don't want to see you for a little bit.
Dad! I'm grown up, leave me alone!
Dad, I'm having a good day right now, I don't want to ruin it talking to you.
Dad, I've been having a bad day, don't make it worse bothering me please.
female.adultp.dialogue.human_greet.negat: Mom! I don't care about what you have to say right now! Go away!
I love you mom, but I don't want to talk to you for a while.
Mom, I don't want to see you around for a little bit.
Mom, I'm on my own for a reason, leave me alone please!
Ma, I'm having a good day right now, I don't want to ruin it talking to you.
Mom, I've been having a bad day, please don't make it worse bothering me.
dialogue.human_apologize.success/2: It's okay, just watch yourself next time
dialogue.human_apologize.success/3: I guess that's okay, just be careful.
dialogue.human_apologize.fail/3: Yeah, like I'm gonna fall for that one!
dialogue.location.failed/1: Hmm, no I heard nothing new.
dialogue.location.failed/2: Sorry, but no, there's no interesting places I'd be aware of.
dialogue.location.failed/3: No, I don't think so. Sorry, but we've got better things to do than searching for some monster-filled ruins like you adventurers.
dialogue.location.forgot/1: Oh, I had found a cool location, but I forgot to mark it on the map. Sorry.
dialogue.location.forgot/2: Looking for something interesting? Yes, there was-... wait… wait… darn! I had it on the tip of my tongue! Sorry, I forgot to write that down.
dialogue.location.forgot/3: Yes, there was something, but I just forgot! I'm so sorry!.
dialogue.location.igloo/1: I found an igloo at %2$s. Who would want to live in a house made of snow? Brrr!
dialogue.location.igloo/2: Now that I think of it… there's an abandoned igloo at %2$s. I don't think anyone lives there. And, just between you and me, the place might be haunted. I always hear weird noises whenever I walk by…
dialogue.location.igloo/3: At %2$s there is an abandoned house made of nothing but ice. An igloo, I think it was called. I think it's been abandoned for a good while.
dialogue.location.pyramid/2: They say there's a pyramid at %2$s. Who knows, maybe you could find some worthwhile treasure in there?
dialogue.location.pyramid/3: If you head to %2$s, you will find a pyramid. There was one adventurer, just like you, who went to investigate some good while ago, but we haven't heard from him since. Be careful.
dialogue.location.ruined_portal_desert/1: There's a destroyed portal at %2$s, in the middle of the desert.
dialogue.location.ruined_portal_swamp/1: There's a destroyed portal at %2$s, in the middle of the swamp. The invaders from the Nether didn't expect to land in this dump.
dialogue.location.ruined_portal/1: There is a destroyed portal at %2$s, the aftermath of a Nether invasion.
dialogue.location.ruined_portal/2: Head to %2$s, and you'll find a ruined nether portal. It looks pretty damn creepy if you ask me, but it should be safe. Just don't step on the magma.
dialogue.location.ruined_portal/3: If you go to %2$s, you'll find some ancient ruins. The local cleric says it used to be a nether portal. Some also say there might be treasure, but nobody wants to go anywhere near that place
dialogue.location.ruined_portal_mountain: There's a destroyed portal at %2$s in the mountains.
dialogue.location.mansion/1: If you go to %2$s, then you'll find a mansion owned by the illagers. If you value your life, don't come anywhere near that accursed place.
dialogue.location.mansion/2: There's this giant mansion at %2$s owned by illagers. I don't know, but if you ask me, maybe we really should move the village… far away from here, preferably…
dialogue.location.monument/1: There is a sunken castle guarded by sea monsters at %2$s. Steer clear of it.
dialogue.location.monument/2: There are tales of ancient ruins deep in the ocean at %2$s. You might find treasure in there, but it is going to be dangerous.
dialogue.location.shipwreck/1: I found a sunken ship at %2$s. This sunken ships in the oceans once belonged to the Eastern Alliance Company.
dialogue.location.shipwreck/2: I've heard some fishermen stumbled on a shipwreck at %2$s. I wonder if there is some treasure hidden inside…
dialogue.location.shipwreck_beached/1: I found a ruined ship at %2$s, at the beach. You can't miss it.
dialogue.location.shipwreck_beached/2: Go to %2$s, and you will find a ship wrecked on the shore. I wonder how it ended up there, though…
dialogue.location.village_desert/1: At %2$s is another lovely village, in the middle of a desert.
dialogue.location.village_taiga/1: At %2$s is another lovely village, in the middle of a taiga biome.
dialogue.location.village_taiga/2: Go to %2$s and you will find another village. It's deep in the taiga biome, if I remember it right.
dialogue.location.village_snowy/1: At %2$s is another village. It's very cold there.
dialogue.location.village_snowy/2: There is another village at %2$s in snowy plains. The people are so nice, but it's so cold in there!.
dialogue.location.village_plains/2: Deep into the plain at %2$s you will find another village.
dialogue.location.village_savanna/1: At %2$s is another village. It's soooo hot over there.
dialogue.location.village_savanna/2: In the savanna at %2$s, you can find another village. Very nice people, too!
dialogue.location.swamp_hut/1: There is a witch living in the swamp at %2$s. If I were you, I would avoid that damn place.
dialogue.location.swamp_hut/2: If I were you, I would avoid %2$s. There's this hut owned by that foul witch, and trust me, you don't want to be anywhere nearby.
dialogue.location.mineshaft/1: We used to have a mine here, but it got closed after that one accident. Should be around %2$s.
dialogue.location.mineshaft/2: Oh, yes. There was this mine we once owned, right at %2$s, but it got infested with monsters and it's not safe anymore. Please be careful if you choose to go down there.
dialogue.location.jungle_pyramid/1: There is an ancient temple at %2$s. If you value your life, you should avoid it or you might get killed by one of the traps.
dialogue.location.jungle_pyramid/2: If you go to %2$s in the nearby jungle, you will find ancient ruins. I won't tell you what to do, but be careful if you go. By some miracle, those ancient traps still work.. Otherwise, our forefathers would have looted the place ourselves decades ago.
dialogue.location.pillager_outpost/1: There is a group of Pillagers at %2$s. They set up an outpost right next to us. Hopefully they won't attack us too soon, we can't stand another attack.
dialogue.location.pillager_outpost/2: There's this outpost owned by pillagers at %2$s that won't let us sleep at night. If you go anywhere near there, be careful. They shoot on sight.
dialogue.location.pillager_outpost/3: Well… if you head to %2$s, you will find an outpost owned by the pillagers. If you can best those wretched villains, maybe you'll find some worthwhile loot. The entire village would be thankful if someone took care of them.
dialogue.location.ancient_city/0: I heard weird noises at %2$s, deep underground.
dialogue.location.ancient_city/1: I think something is hidden far beneath the ground at %2$s.
dialogue.location.ancient_city/3: Legends say at %2$s is an ancient city. I didn't see anything tho, maybe its underground?
dialogue.human_joke.monster.success/2: What? That zombie really tried to beat you to death with a shovel? Hahaha!
dialogue.human_joke.monster.success/3: You really showed that spider who's boss! Haha!
dialogue.human_joke.monster.success/4: Hey, you really got a skeleton to kill a creeper?! Now that's amazing, haha!!
dialogue.human_joke.monster.success/5: Hahah! God, are cave spiders really this dumb?!
dialogue.human_joke.monster.failed/1: Skeletons are sentient beings! How dare you!
dialogue.human_joke.monster.failed/2: ... Who jokes about creepers blowing up in this day and age? Seriously!
dialogue.human_joke.monster.failed/3: Zombies and skeletons used to be humans just like us, in case you forgot.
dialogue.human_joke.monster.failed/4: Wow. An enderman fell into water. Soooo original.
dialogue.human_joke.monster.failed/5: If I had a nickel for every time someone joked about being ambushed by a silverfish on the toilet, I would have two nickels. And it's not much, but it's weird it has just happened again.
dialogue.human_joke.animal.success/1: Unfortunate for the sheep to lose its wool, but funny!
dialogue.human_joke.animal.success/2: Then the wolf fell in love with the sheep.
dialogue.human_joke.animal.success/3: That's hilarious! I can't believe chickens can do that!
dialogue.human_joke.animal.success/4: That's so stupid, i love it!
dialogue.human_joke.animal.failed/2: That poor sheep! That's not funny at all!
dialogue.human_joke.animal.failed/3: Don't speak about my pig like that!
dialogue.human_joke.animal.failed/5: Don't joke about the cow's eyebrows like that!
dialogue.human_flirt.slap/2: Did a Vindicator teach you how to flirt?!
dialogue.human_kiss.slap/2: Try that again, and the next one's going to leave a mark!
dialogue.human_chat.plains/1: Do you like the plains? I've never been anywhere else. I should travel one day...
dialogue.human_chat.plains/2: The plains are so peaceful. Even if it's not as exciting as it is in other biomes, I still wouldn't want to live anywhere else.
dialogue.human_chat.plains/3: Sometimes at night, the plains biome is very beautiful to look at and listen to.
dialogue.human_chat.plains/4: Times like this, I'd just lay down and look at the sky and clouds.
dialogue.human_chat.plains/5: The air here is so clean and fresh! Maybe better than taiga!
dialogue.human_chat.plains/6: Although the plains are plain, sometimes plain and simple are the best!
dialogue.human_chat.plains/7: Weather like this reminds me when I picked wild flowers as a child. I had a crush on Ash, so I always gave them the flowers.
dialogue.human_chat.plains/8: The morning sunrise is very pretty in the plains! You should observe it sometime.
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/1: It's hot over here in the savanna, but at least we never have to worry about the winter.
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/2: The llamas are sort of annoying, but I enjoy it here.
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/3: I love the architecture here in the savanna. It's very unique and is one of the main reasons I live here.
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/4: Don't underestimate the savanna biome. It may look plain and generic, but it does have its perks.
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/5: One advantage we have over the desert villages is even though it may not rain here, we still have rivers.
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/6: Some of the hills and terrains here are very interesting! Such a sight.
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/7: When it gets hot, the acacia trees having so much shade helps me get through work days!
dialogue.human_chat.savanna/8: Savanna villages usually have some of the best melons and pumpkins in the world, we often trade with other villages!
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/1: I like the woods. They provide building material, firewood, and are great hunting grounds.
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/2: Some say it's cold here in the taiga biome, but if you ask me, we have pretty much all we need here. I wouldn't change it for anything!
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/3: Taiga forests are so cool! I love the sweet berries.
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/4: I adore foxes here in the taiga forests. I feed them sweet berries sometimes. Such mischievous creatures.
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/5: Since there is a lot of potential food here, the wolves are pretty tame with us.
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/6: The fresh crisp air the taiga brings is so relaxing at times.
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/7: Although the sweet berry bushes have the best berries, getting pricked by one is awful!
dialogue.human_chat.taiga/8: The rain here in the taiga gets pretty cold, but it's very peaceful to say the least.
child.dialogue.human_chat.taiga/1: Did you see the foxes? I really want one as a pet, but they are so fast. Can you catch one for me?
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/1: It's cold here, but as long as there is enough firewood it's no problem for me.
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/2: It's freezing out here, but at least there's plenty of fish. Haha!
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/3: In weather like this, it's perfect for snuggling myself in a blanket reading a book by the furnace!
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/4: When it snows here, it takes me back to my childhood where me and a couple of friends would have snowball fights. I really miss those times.
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/5: At night, the strays are awful when walking around the village, their tipped arrows suck!
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/6: Be careful of wolves, the guards have spotted some nearby.
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/7: One thing I find awful is when you touch an iron golem. You're practically stuck for the whole day!
dialogue.human_chat.snowy_plains/8: When I was a child, my parents would bring me a pumpkin. I always built snow golems with them after we used the pumpkin for pie!
dialogue.human_chat.desert/1: It's hot here in the desert, but at least we never have to worry about the winter.
dialogue.human_chat.desert/2: The desert is warm all year round.
dialogue.human_chat.desert/3: Although it's hot here in the desert, I'll always have a tan, or a sunburn..
dialogue.human_chat.desert/4: At night it's very scenic and cooler, very nice to look at the stars.
dialogue.human_chat.desert/5: Phew! Never thought I'd say this, but the sun is pretty bad today.
dialogue.human_chat.desert/6: Phew! The sun is pretty bad today!
dialogue.human_chat.desert/7: Have you found any rabbits? They're hard to see here!
dialogue.human_chat.desert/8: One downside about living here are the husks. No matter what, you get super hungry when they smack you! What gives!?
dialogue.human_chat.desert/9: Pricked myself on a cactus the other day. Gotta mind your step around here!
dialogue.human_chat.desert/10: Life in the dry desert is not easy, but at least we have this village where we can get water and food.
dialogue.human_story.exploring.success/1: Cool! I'll explore the world too, one day!.
dialogue.human_story.exploring.success/2: Wow! It must be amazing to just get to travel and explore. I love my village, family and friends, but listening to you really makes me feel jealous!
dialogue.human_story.exploring.success/3: You must be really brave to just go and explore the unknown.
dialogue.human_story.exploring.fail/2: Wow. Don't cut yourself on that edge, tough guy.
dialogue.human_story.exploring.fail/3: Talking to you feels like talking to a child who they want to be when they grow up. Without the adorable part, that is.
dialogue.human_story.nether.success/2: Wow, how have you even managed to survive in such a treacherous place? I'm impressed.
dialogue.human_story.nether.success/3: I've heard there is lots of treasure in the Nether for those brave enough to go there. If only I were brave enough to try and set foot in the Nether…
dialogue.human_story.nether.success/4: You must be really brave to go there. Aren't you scared when you go? N-Not that I would be…
dialogue.human_story.nether.success/5: Have you seen a Zombified Piglin?
dialogue.human_story.nether.fail/1: I don't think you've ever set foot into the Nether.
dialogue.human_story.nether.fail/2: ... now I get why those Piglins attacked you.
dialogue.human_story.nether.fail/3: I don't care if you've been to the Nether. You couldn't tell a story to save your life.
dialogue.human_story.nether.fail/4: ... you don't look nearly strong enough to go to the Nether.
dialogue.human_story.nether.fail/5: My grandpa used to explore the Nether, and he never told me about warped fungus. You liar!
dialogue.human_story.enderdragon.success: Incredible! And did you bring the dragon egg with you?
Oh my! Have you really killed the mighty dragon of legend?! The village will sing of your endeavors for generations!
dialogue.human_story.enderdragon.fail/1: Hah! Have you gone nuts?. The ender dragon is a myth.
dialogue.human_story.enderdragon.fail/2: You must be joking. No human could even hope to scratch that dragon!
dialogue.human_story.wither.success/1: Impossible! I've heard the Wither causes unimaginable destruction!
dialogue.human_story.wither.success/2: You've bested even the Wither?! T-That's incredible!
dialogue.human_story.wither.fail/2: You look too much in one piece for that to be true.
dialogue.human_divorce: Do you really want a divorce? A cleric can provide divorce papers to decrease penalties.
dialogue.human_procreate: Do you really want a child?
dialogue.human_adopt: Do you really want to be my parent?
dialogue.stay.fail/1: Nah thanks, I'm more the adventurer.
dialogue.stay.fail/2: Thanks for asking, but I prefer to venture and explore the world!
dialogue.stay.fail/3: It's a nice village, but I'm more the adventurer type.
dialogue.stay.repeat/1: You already asked me this question.
dialogue.stay.success/1: Thanks, I would love to stay at this village!
dialogue.stay.success/2: Awesome, I would love to stay at this village!
dialogue.stay.no_space/1: Hmm, this village seems pretty crowded already.
dialogue.stay.no_space/2: Maybe I would like to stay, but there are no beds left.
dialogue.human_divorcePapers: Here you go, bring these papers to your spouse to confirm the divorce.
dialogue.human_hire/1: Alright, just tell me when you need help. I will be around for the paid time.
dialogue.human_hire/2: Cool! Let me know when you need me. I'll be here for the emeralds!
dialogue.human_hire/3: Great! You won't be disappointed! Just have the emeralds ready!
dialogue.no_money/1: You need more emeralds to hire me!
dialogue.no_money/2: Are you trying to rip me off? You need more emeralds!
dialogue.no_money/3: I may look cheap, but my services aren't. You will need more to hire me.
villager.grieving/1: How could this happen? He was always so full of life.
villager.grieving/2: I can't believe she is gone. This is just too much to bear.
villager.grieving/3: Why did you have to leave us so soon.
villager.grieving/4: I'm going to miss you so much.
villager.grieving/5: I don't know how I'll go on without you.
villager.grieving/6: This grave is a constant reminder of the pain I feel without you.
villager.grieving/7: I hope you're in a better place now
villager.grieving/8: I'll always cherish the memories I have with you
dialogue.human_rock_paper_scissor/2: I'm going to beat you this time!
I'm going to go with scissors this time!
dialogue.human_rock_paper_scissor.win.ro: Ahh, rock crushes scissor, I lost.
dialogue.human_rock_paper_scissor.win.pa: I can never seem to win with rock.
dialogue.human_rock_paper_scissor.win.sc: Scissors cut paper, you got me this time.
